en.title: PEG 3350 and electrolytes for oral solution: 7.2 and 2.1 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: 7.2 reads “Administer oral medications within one hour before the start of administration of GoLYTELY”. 2.1 reads “Do not take oral medications within 1 hour before the start or during administration”. Example: A tablet taken 30 minutes before the opening dose follows 7.2 and breaks 2.1, Highlights and 17. The same text is in 9 labels from 8 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: medium. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
